The contract sets PPN at 11% (clause KTR-V-019#3.1). Let me verify the arithmetic.

11% × 9,979,800 = 1,097,778. Invoice tax is 1,197,576. That's 12% × 9,979,800 = 1,197,576. So a 12% rate was applied — wrong_tax_rate.
